body:
Read all 1739 lines of SWORD_II_MASTER.md. Set it up as the standing doctrine: created a real Skill (~/.claude/skills/sword-master-tungsten/) so "sword master tungsten" reliably re-loads and runs it in any future session, plus memory files tracking the charter itself and a running execution log against its ship order (so progress survives even if I lose this conversation).

Then started the actual work. Part VIII.4 is the current authoritative ship order (it explicitly supersedes the earlier Part VII.7 one) -- step 1 is path-state capture, "nothing else is possible first."

SHIPPED: WARRANT#170. Extended the EA's existing per-trade tracking struct (it already had entryRegime/currentRegime/regimeChanged and holdingMinutes -- didn't duplicate that) with entryATR, mfeATR, maeATR, currentRATR, barsHeld, barsToMFE, barsToMAE, and a rolling favor/adverse sequence string. Wired into the trade-creation and per-tick trade-update functions, both confirmed live. Pure instrumentation -- reads existing state, writes only the new fields, sizes nothing, changes no live decision. 0 errors/0 warnings, marker-verified before propagating, byte-identical across all 3 locations.

Deliberately did NOT capture one field the spec names (exposureHistory) -- it's defined as "the CEA function's own prior outputs," and CEA doesn't exist yet. Faking that field would be inventing data and calling it real. Named the gap instead of hiding it.

Honest state: this is one real step of what the document itself calls a multi-week program. Steps 2-10 (export bridge, relabelling, meta-model, CPCV, DSR/PBO, CEA shadow) are not started. The one thing that's parallel-eligible right now is net-b measurement from live fills -- but there are none yet, market hasn't opened since anything shipped tonight.

Say "sword master tungsten" any time and I'll re-read the live document and continue from wherever the execution log says it actually is -- not from memory.
